name: MCP-Universe
intro: MCP-Universe 通过真实 MCP 服务器和执行式评估器测试智能体的工具使用能力。它包含位置导航、代码仓库管理、金融分析、3D 设计、浏览器自动化和网页搜索六个领域，共 11 个服务器、133 个工具和 231 个任务。
build_method: 人工任务设计, 人工与自动验证
metric: 成功率, 平均评估器得分
eval_feature: 长文本, 零样本, 过程评估, 工具调用
scale: 231 个任务, 11 个服务器, 133 个工具
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Zero-shot, Process evaluation, Tool invocation
intro_en: MCP-Universe tests agent tool use through real MCP servers and execution-based evaluators. It contains 231 tasks over 11 servers and 133 tools in six domains: location navigation, repository management, financial analysis, 3D design, browser automation, and web search.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.14704, Sections 3.1-3.4 and 4.1. The paper integrates 11 real MCP servers with 133 tools across six domains; manually creates four or five scenario types per domain; rejects tasks solvable without MCP or consistently solvable with MCP within five retries; cross-checks all 231 tasks; creates and cross-checks 84 execution evaluators (4 format, 32 static, 48 dynamic); automatically configures each LLM-agent, server, resource, endpoint, and evaluator combination; records MCP interactions; and reports binary task success rate plus average evaluator score.
